Page 299 Cont.
Sep. 12 Mrs. Wand. Cox - 36 - spiritest, fears she is controlled by two devils. - raised Catholic till about ten, when mother died - lost father a year later - 17 yrs. since receiving the holy sacraments, Conf. & Com. - never confirmed - inscribed in S.M.A.
12th Thanks - Helen Dunbar - 55 - Ist operation on Good Friday - inward goi- tre - 2nd 25th of April - 3rd May 8; June 23 tuomer removed from breast O.K. now.
13 Thomas Rooney - middle-aged - hardening of liver - now at Mayo's .... has five children with non-catholic wife - for ten yrs in asylum Kala- mazoo. . Enrolled Today 50c by neighbor.
Page 300
Sep. 13 Joseph Fraser - 49 - in Kiefer's - paralysis ... now finds breathing very difficult.
14 Nany L. - 4 in November - Lukemia - Drs. give her a month to live; was enrolled and prayed for July 8th - 5. After enrollment and prayers be- fore there seemed a change almost miraculous-for a time then turned worse; seems bright To-day and alert. Deo Gr.
Mrs. Anna Lang - 67 - Neck broken in Auto Crash - Enrolled % phone Sept. 9 - 4 days later - seemingly coming O.K.
15 June Bigger - 63 - with religion
16 Gertrude Carmichael - 54 - hard of hearing - has twin sister a nun and for many years has been a daily communicant.
Edw'd Owens .... 21 ... Hodg'kins disease
David Alen Smith - 6 - presbiterian - infantile para.
Marian Stevens - 29 - to be married Saturday (20th) "boy friend" says he believes but does not practice religion.
Page 301 Sep. 22 Carol Ann Jones - 5 - mongolian type.
22
Celine Mrs. Marchand - 81 - rhumatism - losing sight ....
23 Wm. Wetmore - 20 - Niles, Mich. - now in Ann Arbor - Bone & Joint Clinic - one of 15 children - poor but astonishing faith, one sis- ter a nun .... Drs. now making steel harness have no hope of his ever using arm or let.
